run.starts: the four registered DISPERSED starts (6E1B dispersed_starts[0..3]), unchanged

gates_preregistered.seventeen_frozen_gates: all 7 distributional + 11 R-hat gates of the Stage 6E1B compare, verbatim, thresholds unchanged — ALL must pass

primary_multivariate_gate_prospective.extraction: 1000 equally spaced retained draws per chain (stride 48, offset 0) over the FULL retained window, concatenated 4x1000=4000, equal chain contribution
primary_multivariate_gate_prospective.coordinates: [closures, TOTAL segment count, scalars] — identical to the dependence-calibration study

primary_multivariate_gate_prospective.dependence: within-chain circular moving-block bootstrap, 150 replicates; block length L = ceil(max IACT of the contribution series over the four chain segments), sensitivity {max(2,L//2), L, 2L}
primary_multivariate_gate_prospective.decision: z_bal = (T_obs - T_7b1) / sqrt(SE_obs^2 + SE_7b1^2) <= 2.33 at ALL three lengths

gates_preregistered.supporting_per_chain_check: full-window per-chain dependence-aware z (mu0 = mean full-window T of the four 7B1 chains, same machinery as the calibration study): at most 1 of 4 chains > 2.33 at all lengths; 2+ chains over => INCONCLUSIVE, not FAIL

verdict_rules.PASS -> COLLAPSED-U KERNEL VALIDATED: all 17 frozen gates pass AND primary balanced gate <= 2.33 at all lengths AND supporting check <= 1/4 over
verdict_rules.FAIL -> NOT VALIDATED: any frozen gate fails OR primary balanced gate > 2.33 at all lengths
